name: takes
description: A take is one draft prompt. A session can hold several. Start a new one when they change subject entirely, park the current one when they want to come back to it, and switch when they do.

take_id.description: Required for switch, park, and discard.

label.description: For new. A few of their words so they can recognize it later.

carry_context.description: For new. Bring the current take's resolved context along, when the new request is about the same thing.
